description: "Before your agent pays, call OceanAlt once." Pass the payee address the agent is about to pay; get a machine-executable decision: allow | review | decline, plus verifiable evidence and retry semantics — use it as a gate: if the decision is not "allow", do not pay. On allow/review it also returns a verifiable compliance attestation you can attach to the settlement so the payment carries proof it passed OceanAlt's decision. Free, no API key.

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC (optional; recorded, not required for the decision).

lang.description: Language for human-readable fields (signals, note, advice). Defaults to English.

maxAmountUsdc.description: Optional declared per-payment cap in USDC. amountUsdc above it → decline.

network.description: EVM chain for the payee (optional; ignored for Tron).

reasoning.description: Optional payment intent: why this payee. Instruction-override phrases here route the payment to review.

task.description: Optional payment intent: what this payment is for. Sending task, reasoning or maxAmountUsdc opts into a deterministic intent check; an empty intent is itself a finding (requires_information).

to.description: Payee address the agent is about to pay. EVM: 0x + 40 hex. Tron: T + 33 base58.

name: payment_decision
title: Decide whether this payment should happen (free)
